excerpts.text: Welcome to Visiting Angels Scotch Plains NJ! We are an award-winning, non-medical provider of in home senior care. Our agency proudly serves the elderly and disabled throughout the area. The assistance we provide allows our clients to continue living independently at home when physical challenges might otherwise stop them. If you or a loved one are in need of non-medical assistance and wish to avoid moving to a facility, in home senior care from Visiting Angels Scotch Plains NJ can help.

In addition to customizing your in home senior care services, Visiting Angels Scotch Plains NJ will schedule care according to your wishes. Whether you need assistance overnight to keep a loved one safe and help with trips to the bathroom, or a joyful companion to help out during the day we have you covered.
